description: Explicit NHFLOW (SSP-RK2) with the fourth-order horizontal operators of the projection in the non-incremental projection (A 520 1) on two ranks: free oscillation in a closed basin 1.6 m x 1.6 m, 0.4 m deep, 32 x 32 x 4 cells, initial surface cos(2 pi x/L) cos(pi y/L) set in 16 x 16 boxes (F 72). 200 steps.
covers: nhflow_pjm_ho: divx, divy, gradx, grady in nhflow_pjm (rhs, ucorr, vcorr)
